description: Returns a kitchen's upcoming pickup and delivery times that are open for ordering, each with its order cutoff and the pickup place name. Kitchens with scheduled times list each slot; kitchens with weekly pickup list each pickup time and the dishes it serves. Street addresses are never included.

kitchen.description: Kitchen slug or storefront link, e.g. "stephanie-s-bite-of-heaven" or "https://app.stovefront.com/<slug>"

name: get_pickup_windows

delivery.description: Weekly-pickup kitchens: whether the cook delivers. Scheduled-slot kitchens list delivery times in windows.

orderCutoffAt.description: Last moment to order for this time

place.description: Pickup place name; never a street address

slotId.description: Scheduled time id (scheduled-slot kitchens); null for fixed weekly pickup

startAt.description: RFC 3339 with the kitchen's UTC offset

title: Get pickup and delivery times
